name: Panera Warm Oatmeal (Plain Oats, Pecans & Berries Omitted)
searchKeywords: steel cut oats panera no nuts
whyItWorks: Warm steel-cut and rolled oats slow-cooked in water and organic soy milk. When modified to omit crunchy whole pecans (stricture hazard) and seedy strawberries, it provides soothing beta-glucan soluble fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Steel Cut Oatmeal—HOLD the cinnamon crunch topping, HOLD the pecans, HOLD the fresh strawberries.' Sweeten with brown sugar or pure honey.
